gaps.info: Ventricular rate on ECG (e.g., <100 vs. ≥110 bpm)
gaps.discriminates: Differentiates hemodynamically significant (e.g., tachycardia-mediated cardiomyopathy risk, urgent rate control need) vs. controlled AF; also helps distinguish AF from other irregular rhythms like multifocal atrial tachycardia if rate were very slow or variable in pattern
Distinguishes ischemic (e.g., acute coronary syndrome-triggered) AF from idiopathic/primary AF — critical for management urgency and prognosis

gaps.info: Transthoracic echocardiogram findings (e.g., left atrial volume index, LV ejection fraction, valvular structure)
gaps.discriminates: Differentiates valvular vs. non-valvular AF (impacting anticoagulation choice), identifies structural substrate (e.g., LA enlargement supporting chronicity or progression risk), and excludes mimics like atrial flutter with variable block if structural clues suggest organized atrial activity
